comments.node_modules: Intentionally NOT installed in this directory. Resolved via NODE_PATH to C:/Users/Admin/.openclaw/workspace/node_modules. Run `npm install` locally if forking to a fresh host.
comments.playwright: Required only for the LinkedIn fallback path. Other sources use MCP web_fetch / browser MCP.
comments.resend: Required for the digest email send. API key loaded from secrets.md / env.
comments.openpgp: Optional. Used by scripts/backup.js if/when archive encryption is enabled.
